topics.description: Trump administration froze federal child care funding nationwide after viral video exposed alleged fraud in Minnesota daycare centers. Originally targeted Minnesota, now affects all 50 states.
keyDevelopments: HHS demands audit before funds resume

topics.description: YouTuber Nick Shirley's video exposing closed Minnesota daycares still in the payment system went viral, prompting federal response and triggering community backlash.
Ongoing sentencing and forfeiture proceedings in the $250M+ Feeding Our Future fraud case. Aimee Bock ordered to forfeit $5.2M.
